title: Apartment MEP – First Fix (pre-close)
activity: Pipework, drainage, ductwork and testing before close-up
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Is pipework supported at the specified spacing with the correct clips?
Pressure test done (7 bar as spec) with a signed certificate before boxing in?
questions.source: BAF / Borough ITP – pipework pressure test

questions.q: Is waste pipework at a fall of 18 mm per 1 m, air tested and certified?
Is pipe insulation complete and neat, with no gaps?
Are inlet and exhaust ducts fully insulated, with fire sleeves fitted per the BWIC drawings?
Sprinkler pipework hydraulic test (15 bar, BS 9251) certified?
Are isolation valves accessible after close-up?
